entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Macedonian Chambers of Commerce)
why_relevant: A third chamber body (chamber.mk) distinct from mchamber.mk and OEMVP; its sections and elected officers add another slice of the business-association map. Only an active social presence was confirmed in this pass, so the social page is offered as the entry point to reach the organisation's current web home.

entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
why_relevant: Described as the first fintech community in Macedonia, initiated by fintech practitioners. It is not a formal association with elected governance, but its events and organiser names reveal who the active fintech operators and evangelists are — useful for enumerating early-stage payments actors that no chamber directory captures. Note: no independent .mk association website was confirmed in this pass.

entity_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia
source_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia (DevelopmentAid, Hook/SellToState, GTBC, TendersInfo-type services)
why_relevant: Third-party services that normalise, translate and alert on MK notices and on donor tenders naming MK. Useful as a cross-check that a notice existed (and for historic notices removed from the source portal), and their sector taxonomies surface banking/payments tenders that keyword search misses. Content is mostly paywalled.

source_name: Datanyze / ZoomInfo / AroundDeal / Lusha — third-party employee-and-headcount aggregators for MK banks and CaSys
why_relevant: These B2B data vendors resell LinkedIn-derived management lists and headcount estimates for MK institutions (Silk Road Bank, NLB Banka, CaSys). Relevant as a documented ALTERNATIVE access path when LinkedIn itself is gated — but they are scraped derivatives with stale records and personal data, so treat as low-credibility and legally sensitive.

source_name: Dun & Bradstreet business directory — MK vendor company profiles
why_relevant: Provides employee counts and revenue estimates per MK vendor entity (Nextsense d.o.o. Skopje observed at ~88 employees / ~USD 8.68m). Useful for sizing supplier delivery capacity and normalising hiring counts against base headcount.

source_name: Glassdoor — Skopje office pages & salary data for MK delivery centres
why_relevant: Per-company, per-location pages for the Skopje centres (G+D Netcetera, Nextsense observed) with salary points and review volume. Review-volume growth and salary drift are proxies for headcount growth and competition for payments engineers in Skopje.

source_name: IOM North Macedonia — Procurement / consultancy services
why_relevant: Another IO contracting authority in-country publishing consultancy calls; occasionally covers digital payments/cash-transfer and financial-inclusion work. Adds to the donor-route supplier and expert population.

source_name: MarketScreener / TheOfficialBoard / TheOrg — commercial board & org-chart aggregators
why_relevant: Aggregate board/manager rosters for MK subsidiaries (NLB Banka AD Skopje, Sparkasse Bank Macedonia, Halkbank AD Skopje incl. executive director Turhan Ademi) — cheap change-detection, but must be corroborated against the parent or NBRM.

source_name: NLB d.d. — Management and Supervisory Board pages (SI)
why_relevant: Roster page revealing where MK country executives move to/from within the group (e.g. Antonio Argir's move from NLB Banka Skopje to the Ljubljana HQ); useful as a change-detection target.

source_name: Open Data Macedonia — Завод за статистика / Пазар на труд / Плати
why_relevant: Third-party mirror of labour-market and wage datasets in machine-readable form; useful fallback when the statistical office's own portal is awkward to scrape. Freshness must be validated against stat.gov.mk.

General MK news portal that syndicates/republishes business columns and economy items (observed carrying the same banking column as Nova Makedonija). Chiefly useful as a redundancy net: content that disappears behind a paywall or a site migration elsewhere often survives here.

source_name: Printec Group - North Macedonia country page
why_relevant: Vendor's own MK entity page (Printec Technologies Skopje, in market since 2006); paired with the group Leadership page it is the authoritative statement of who runs the MK operation and how it is positioned.

entity_name: Reuters/SEE News syndicated feed on TradingView
source_name: Reuters/SEE News syndicated feed on TradingView
why_relevant: SEE News items on MK banks (Uni Banka, Komercijalna, NLB Banka) appear syndicated on TradingView news pages, which are often readable when the SeeNews original is gated — a practical paywall workaround for headline/date/lede capture.

Official MSE mobile client for listed-company disclosures. Its existence implies a backing JSON/mobile API for SEINet that would be a cleaner, more stable ingestion path than scraping the SPA — worth reverse-engineering as a collection route.

source_name: Western Balkans InfoHub — mirrored EC enlargement reports
why_relevant: Independent mirror of EC country report PDFs; useful fallback when the EC document-download endpoint rotates URLs, and a way to retain superseded editions for year-on-year diffing.
